name: Runner's Lunge with Thoracic Extension
instructions: Step into a deep runner's lunge, back knee resting on the floor.
Place both hands on the front thigh.
Lift the chest and gently arch the mid-back, looking slightly upward.
Feel the hip-flexor stretch and hold 20-30 seconds per side, breathing deeply.
cues: Stay relaxed outside the target area
longevityNotes: Mobility is use-it-or-lose-it. Ten minutes of daily joint work preserves the ranges that keep you independent — reaching, bending, and getting up from the floor.
overview: A beginner just your bodyweight mobility drill targeting the glutes. Runner's Lunge with Thoracic Extension restores range of motion that desk life and hard training both tend to steal.
